svg.title: Complete preemption policy: triggers, protection, ranking, retry and restoration
svg.desc: Two trigger paths join enablement, safety filtering, victim ranking and CPU snapshot. Requester retry and victim restoration have separate branches. Defer, stop admission, repeated waiting, cancellation and copy-error outcomes are explicit.
svg.text: One shared selection path. Then two lifecycles: requester retry and victim restoration.
Safety first. Priority-admission filtering is stricter than capacity-pressure filtering.
Larger priority number loses first; footprint breaks ties. Exact ties follow candidate order.
Other requests can still be selected.
One saved phase; queue labels above are examples.
Split-prefill rewind resumes at chunk PRELUDE.
Failed restore defers without nested KV preemption.
Shared admission: bounded scan; FCFS / priority.
Restore and fresh-admission bypass paths differ.
Discard CPU snapshot → release RNG → abort Request
Exception propagates; no transactional rollback here.
Preemption defaults off; speculation excludes it. CPU swap is current behavior; generic KV recompute / cost-based victim selection are not implemented.
